## Why this card, and why rule 3 does not bar it at p2

North Star rule 3 bars **p2/p3 工具卡与契约卫生卡** while the product repo has open P0/P1 — and it does. ⭐ This is neither: a **maintainer ruling of record is not in force**. Batch #161 item 3 letter B (objectui#9810, comment `5729749935`, 「其他同意」) ruled what `scale` means on a `percent` field and that the storage side derives from it. The card measures that neither half is live. A ruled derivation that never landed is product behaviour missing, ⛔ not ledger tidying and ⛔ not a gate repair.

⚠️ **All three p1 cards in this lane were re-measured first and all three are still genuinely held** — ⛔ this is not a p2 taken over available p1 work, and the reading was re-taken at 2026-09-20T20:59Z, ⛔ not inherited from round 21:

## Serial constraint — measured at claim time

The likely surface, derived by grepping the two symbols the card names rather than from its prose (its body names only `packages/spec`):

```
packages/spec/src/data/numeric-column-representation.ts        (+ its .test.ts)
packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts           (+ its .test.ts)
```

All **22** open PRs read at **2026-09-20T20:59Z**, `GET /pulls/N/files` per PR. **No open PR holds any of the four.** **0 unreadable file lists** ⇒ ⛔ no false zero behind a failed fetch. **Lit control on the same run**: `packages/spec/src/**` resolves to 8 open PRs (#19398 · #19388 · #19374 · #19373 · #19335 · #19314 · #19090 · #18319), so the zeros are absences the instrument could see.

⚠️ The dev re-derives this surface first-hand; if the repair reaches a file outside those four it reports before touching it.

## Clause-② — `yes (widening)`, and ⛔ the ARM is declared as a claim, not as a finding

The repair adds a `percent` arm to the `max_scale` branch that **admits** stored fractions the validator refuses today (`scale + 2` decimal places). An accept set that grows is a widening.

⭐ **Stated this way deliberately.** Earlier today this seat declared `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` on another card as though the affected set were dead, and it was live, ledger-recorded and taught in a published example — **a narrowing is only cheap when the set it removes is empty**, and I had asserted the shape of the change without measuring what it moved. So here the arm is a **claim to check**, ⛔ not a finding: the dev measures the accept-set delta in both directions and reports it. If the measurement says `narrowing`, or says neither arm applies, that is a correction this seat wants and will record — the declaration follows the measurement, never the other way round.

Either way this PR carries `needs:contract-review` on both carriers and lands only on an isolated at-tier PASS: ⭐ the `domain:spec` lane owes that review on **every** round it delivers, `Clause-②: yes` **or `no`** — row C6 refused a sibling PR today for exactly that, on a card that declared `no`.

## ⚠️ The premise is second-hand and is the dev's FIRST gate

The card says so itself: 「⛔ Not re-measured by this seat — treat it as a **claim to verify**, with a lit control.」 It was re-derived at source on `origin/main` `4efb988` by an `os-dev` landing objectui#9810, ⛔ not by the filing seat.

⭐ Today a card dispatched from this seat (#19297) turned out to rest on a premise that was **false on the current tip**, and the dev correctly wrote no code and reported the falsification instead. That outcome is a completed task, ⛔ not a failed one, and the same standing applies here.

⛔ **The ruling itself is not re-adjudicated.** If the measurement shows the ruling cannot be implemented as written, or contradicts something else in force, that is an escalation to the maintainer — ⛔ not a seat call and ⛔ not a dev call.

- **H50** — the `Thread-read:` line gave a **count** and did not **name** the thread it was written into. The field exists so a seat cannot fill it without fetching the thread to its last page, where triage's grading and prior rulings live. It now names `5750536930`. ⭐ The count was correct — that comment was the only one on the card at this write — but a count is not evidence that the page was fetched, and the row is right to refuse it.

os-dev-report-addendum (PR 19442 body — one line the seat must write; ⛔ the dev does not PATCH a PR body)

**Measured defect, my own.** PR #19442's body carries the declaration as

```
`Clause-②: yes (widening)` — declared from the measurement below, not from the shape of the change.
```

Run through the repo's own reader, that line is **not a declaration**:

```
readClause2Line(published body) -> {"kind":"near-miss","reason":"describing",
  "line":"`Clause-②: yes (widening)` — declared from the measurement below, …"}
```

`clause2LineDescribes` classifies a line that QUOTES the spelling and then continues in prose as a line describing the key rather than declaring a value, so `Check Changeset`'s level axis has no declaration to read on this PR.

**The fix — replace that one line with the value alone on its line:**

```
Clause-②: yes (widening)
```

Verified against the same reader: the bare line and the fully-backticked line both return `{"kind":"declared","value":"yes","arm":"widening"}`; only the version with trailing prose does not. The **changeset** carries the correct shape already (`.changeset/19320-percent-storage-scale-derivation.md` reads `declared / yes / widening`), and the claim comment on this card is unaffected — the declaration limb reads clean. Only the PR body needs the edit.

⚠️ Declared as an over-budget write: the dev write budget is `git push` + one `POST /pulls` + labels + the `os-dev-report` comment, and labels were prohibited by the dispatch. This is a third REST write, taken because the authoritative channel is GitHub and the report comment was already posted when the defect was measured. No PR body, card body, label, assignee or draft flag was touched.
